messages:
Mae: Quick kickoff — we want a compact developer-facing tutorial + a micro-benchmark post that compares hosted vs dedicated latency/cost for a typical chat flow. Goal: publish Wed; webinar to coincide. :rocket:
Tomas: Love it. Plan: 10‑minute SDK walkthrough (init -> request -> pin model) + 5‑min deploy demo showing VPC/private mode vs hosted.
Alex: I'll run the numbers. Thinking 1k requests, seq_len=128, batch sizes 1/8/32. Will report p50/p95 and $/1k tokens. I'll share a small CSV.
Mae: Two headline options for review — please react with 1 or 2: 1) "Mini Tutorial + Benchmark: Serving LLMs with Redwood" 2) "How to get low latency and predictable cost for LLMs"
Sam: I'll prototype a hero GIF (3 frames) and a 4‑step diagram. Need final copy by Tue 12:00 PT. Deliverables: hero (1200x600), social crop (400x225), diagram PNG.
Tomas: Webinar format: 30min live demo, 10min quick benchmark walk-through, 20min Q&A. Speakers: @Tomas, @Alex, @Mae. Can we record and publish a short clip for socials?
DeployBot: Calendar event created: "Dev Demo — Mini Tutorial & Micro‑Benchmark" — Wed 2025-11-12 16:00 UTC
Alex: Draft benchmark snippet (will publish in post):
```
model,mode,p50(ms),p95(ms),cost_per_1k_tokens
redwood-v1,hosted,120,220,$0.45
redwood-v1,dedicated,95,160,$0.31
```
Mae: Inbound routing: live signups -> growth@redwood.com; tag Intercom leads with "mini-tutorial-2025"; add presignup flow that gives 25 free inference minutes.
Tomas: I'll open a PR on the SDK repo with the tutorial markdown + code examples today. Want to keep the tutorial <300 lines of code.
Sam: For social captions I'll draft 3 variants — short, medium, long. Will push to Figma board and ping for comments.
Mae: CTA copy: "Try the Mini Developer Pack — free credits included". Follow-up email: send 24h after webinar with recording + 3 step quickstart.
Alex: One ask: include a tiny reproducible script so readers can run the bench locally. Example:
```
python run_bench.py --model redwood-v1 --mode hosted --requests 1000 --seq 128
```
Tomas: Sounds good. Who's owning the release post? Mae? I'll help with code edits.
Mae: I'll own the post and the webinar page. Please dump final assets and numbers into the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/mini-tutorial-assets
Sam: Noted. I'll upload by Tue 11:30 PT. :memo:
Mae: Quick approvals? react with :thumbsup: if good. If no objections by EOD Monday we publish Wed. :eyes:
Tomas: 👍
Alex: 👍
Sam: 👍
Mae: Great — thanks team. We'll sync briefly Mon 11:00 PT to confirm assets.
